verdict.rationale: The division's own portal describes an online "streamlined service to file certificates of formation and authorization of business entities" (docs-35, docs-36). The same pages offer online tax/employer registration (docs-32) and online name reservation (docs-14). They also describe a shared payment account for submitting filings (docs-37), so the core form/register/pay transaction is documented as completable online. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end online formation flow, and explicit confirmation of online fee payment for one-off filers.
